recovery.title: Recovery phrase
recovery.intro: These 12 words can rebuild your circle keys on a new phone. Anyone who has them can too, so keep them somewhere only you can get to.
recovery.cardSaved: Save it somewhere that survives this phone
recovery.cardFailed: Could not make your recovery card

recoveryCard.heading: MIMOZA RECOVERY CARD
recoveryCard.restoresAccount: This file restores your account on a new phone.
recoveryCard.keepSafe: Anyone who has it is you, so keep it somewhere only you can reach.
recoveryCard.howToUse: To use it: open Mimoza, sign in, choose “{{option}}”, then “{{button}}”.

restore.title: Recovery phrase
restore.intro: Pick the recovery card you saved, or type the {{total}} words from your old phone, in order, separated by spaces.
restore.alreadyInCircle: This phone is already in a circle. Restoring would lose it.
restore.invalidPhrase: Those words aren't a valid recovery phrase. Check for a typo.
restore.noPhraseInFile: That file doesn't have a recovery phrase in it.
restore.identityNote: This gets your identity back, so when someone lets you into a circle again you return as yourself, with your old posts still yours. You will still need a new invite for each one.

returning.bodyCertain: Your circles are still there. This phone just can't read them yet.
returning.bodyUncertain: We couldn't reach the server to check. If you've had an account, bring it over now. Once this phone makes its own, the old one is out of reach.
returning.useDeviceDescription: Your old phone scans a code from this one. Restores everything.
returning.usePhraseDescription: Comes back as yourself. Someone in each circle still has to let you in.
returning.startFresh: Start fresh instead. Your previous account details will be gone.

startFresh.title: Leave the old account behind?
startFresh.body: You'll get a new identity on this phone. The circles you were in carry on without you, and the people in them keep everything you posted.
startFresh.recordNote: This also clears the record of which circles those were. A recovery phrase found later still proves who you are, but it won't find them for you. The people already in a circle can always invite you back into it.
startFresh.failed: Could not start fresh. Try again.

keyRecovery.title: This device is new to Mimoza
keyRecovery.body: Your account is fine, but this device doesn't have the keys that open your circles yet, and we couldn't recover them here. There are two ways to sort that out.
keyRecovery.scan: I have another device with Mimoza
keyRecovery.scanNote: Open Mimoza there and approve this one. Your circles open right away.
keyRecovery.failed: Could not set up this device
keyRecovery.noDeviceNote: That's fine. This device gets new keys of its own, and your circles open up again as soon as someone already in them passes the keys over.

transfer.subtitle: Any phone or tablet that already has Mimoza set up can bring your circles over to this one. Scan this code from that device and you're back in right away, no need to wait for anyone else.
transfer.instructions: On your other device, open Account and tap Add another device, then point its camera at this code.
transfer.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Go back and try again.
transfer.reassurance: Your other device asks you to confirm before anything is sent. Nothing on this screen is secret on its own.
transfer.noOldPhone: I don't have Mimoza on another device

scanDevice.instructions: Sign in to Mimoza on the device you're adding, then point this camera at the code it shows.
scanDevice.confirmMessage_one: It will hold the same keys as this phone and see your circle. You cannot take that back later.
scanDevice.confirmMessage_other: It will hold the same keys as this phone and see all {{count}} of your circles. You cannot take that back later.
scanDevice.invalidCode: That doesn't look like a Mimoza transfer code.
scanDevice.expiredCode: That code has expired or was already used.
scanDevice.cameraOff: Camera access is off for Mimoza. Turn it on in Settings to scan.
scanDevice.cameraNeeded: Mimoza needs your camera to scan the code.
scanDevice.confirmNote: You will be asked to confirm before anything leaves this phone.

privacy.title: Where your content lives
privacy.contentBody: Everything you add is meant to be encrypted on your device with a key that belongs to the circle, not us. Copies remain on every member's device, and we help you keep an offline backup as well.
privacy.accountBody: Signing in only confirms you're a real person, to prevent abuse. It's stored separately from your circles and is never linked to what you post or who you're with.
privacy.visibilityBody: At rest, we can determine that two entries in the same circle share an author, but never who that person is. We see only that a circle exists, how active it is, and that requests occur, never who made them or what they contain.
privacy.leavingBody: The circle key rotates when someone leaves. They keep what they already downloaded, and receive nothing further.
